body:
Fixes #8110.

- Gate condition: `always() && !contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')` → `!cancelled()` for `ci-early-success`, `ci-success` and `sanitizers-success`. When a needed job is cancelled (for example by `timeout-minutes`), the gate now runs and `FAIL`, which already treats `cancelled` as failure, becomes 1, instead of the gate being skipped (a required check treats skipped as passing). When the whole run is cancelled (e.g. superseded by a newer push), `cancelled()` is true and the gate is still skipped, as before.
- Add `file-changes` to the gates' `needs`, so a failed change detection fails the gate instead of only causing skips. On `workflow_dispatch` and tags `file-changes` is skipped, which `FAIL` accepts.

Checked in a test repository: after a needed job hit its timeout, the dependent gate saw `needs.<job>.result == 'cancelled'` with `cancelled()` false, so it runs under the new condition.

As discussed in #8110: with this change the Windows ARM jobs that currently time out will make `ci-success` fail. Those tests may need to be excluded separately until the runner issue is resolved; I left that out of this PR so it only changes the gate logic.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01Vx41jkTKgrWAx3u5A78K5p

comment_data.body:
```suggestion
    # ci-arm64 excluded from ci-success due to https://developercommunity.microsoft.com/t/MSVC-ARM64-linkexe-hangs-building-Cytho/11167595
    # on Windows. Re-add when that's fixed.
    needs: [file-changes, ci-early-success, ci-all, ci-32bit, ci-typespecs, ci-sharedmodule, ci-module-state, ci-compileall, ci-stdc, ci-lapi, ci-noncpython]
```

My proposal here is just to make the ARM tests an allowed failure for now (this also includes the ARM Linux tests, I'm treating it as not a big deal because we do look at the CI before merging things most of the time).

commit.message:
CI: make success gates fail on cancelled jobs and detector failures

Use 'if: ${{ !cancelled() }}' for ci-early-success, ci-success and
sanitizers-success so that a cancelled need (e.g. a job hitting its
timeout) makes the gate run and fail instead of skipping it, and add
file-changes to their needs so a failed change detection fails the gate.

Fixes #8110.

commit.message:
CI: use always() for the success gates in ci.yml

With `!cancelled()` the gate is skipped when the run itself is cancelled (e.g. someone cancels a failing run), and a skipped required check counts as passing. `always()` runs the gate regardless; it then fails because the needs report `cancelled`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
